In the absence of such a methodology, the Department can no longer confirm that a nationwide shortage of workers exists to reasonably justify keeping the existing occupations in Schedule A or expanding Schedule A to other occupations—even assuming it had the authority to exempt certain occupations from the required labor market test, the Department has no reasonable basis upon which to determine that a national shortage of workers exists in any occupation. The RFI process solidified the Department's growing belief that Schedule A, first established as an administrative measure to reduce processing delays, should be eliminated and all job opportunities subject to part 656 must undergo a labor market test for the reasons explained below. Consequently, ( printed page 73935) the Department is unable to confidently conclude that Schedule A does not undermine INA section 212(a)(5)(A), 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(5)(A), which requires a PERM labor certification from the Department confirming the Secretary's determination that there are insufficient U.S. workers who are able, willing, qualified and available for the job the alien seeks and employment of the alien will not adversely affect the wages and working conditions of U.S. workers in similar jobs.[56] Being unable to justify the continued presence of the current occupations on Schedule A, the Department likewise cannot justify continuing to waive recruitment for U.S. workers as it no longer possesses evidence that there is a nationwide shortage of U.S. workers able, willing, qualified, and available to work as physical therapists or professional nurses, as required for their placement on Schedule A. Further, the INA does not authorize the Department to make a finding of such a shortage or to use such a finding to exempt certain occupations from the requirements of the PERM program.
关于附表A第II类（Group II），劳工部进一步指出，即使能够确定一套用于更新附表A的方法，劳工部仍将继续推进取消附表A第II类。附表A原本旨在适用于劳工部能够确认存在可用美国工人短缺的职业，而非适用于特定个人或类别的外国人。[57]第II类关注的是外国人的资格条件，即外国人如何具备杰出能力。按照目前的文本表述，该法规并未聚焦于职业本身，而如前所述，职业才是附表A应当关注的首要问题。
With regard to Schedule A, Group II, the Department further notes that even if a methodology could be identified to update Schedule A, the Department would still pursue elimination of Schedule A, Group II. Schedule A was intended for occupations for which the Department could identify a shortage of available U.S. workers, not individuals or classes of aliens.[57] Group II focuses on the aliens' qualifications and how the aliens possess exceptional ability. As written now, the regulation does not focus on the occupations, which as stated, was the primary concern for Schedule A.
劳工部(Department)似乎是为配合国会于1976年10月20日对《移民与国籍法》(INA)第212(a)(5)(A)(ii)条所作的修正而将第二组(Group II)纳入附表A(Schedule A)的,该修正要求对申请需要科学或艺术领域杰出能力职位的美国工人进行“同等合格”评估,以此作为将此类申请转交国土安全部(Department of Homeland Security,DHS)的机制,由DHS评估外国人是否具备其所声称的杰出能力,并将该外国人的资格与可获得该工作机会的美国工人的资格进行比较。[58] 按照现行做法,劳工部将不对外国人的“杰出能力”进行评估。DHS具有评估外国人是否具备“杰出能力”的权限和经验。然而,劳工部已确定,更有利于服务和保护美国工人的做法是,先要求依据现行附表A第二组雇用外国人的雇主进行劳动力市场测试,由审证官(CO)评估雇主对美国工人的考虑情况,然后,若雇主提出移民请愿书(Immigrant Petition),再由DHS作出“杰出能力”认定。
It appears that the Department added Group II to Schedule A in connection with Congress' October 20, 1976 amendments to the INA at section 212(a)(5)(A)(ii), which required an “equally qualified” assessment for U.S. workers applying for positions requiring exceptional ability in the sciences or the arts, as a mechanism to route these applications to DHS, where DHS would then assess whether the alien possessed the exceptional ability claimed and compare the alien's qualifications to those of U.S. workers available for the job opportunity.[58] Continuing current practice, the Department will not assess the alien's “exceptional ability.” DHS has the authority and experience to assess whether the alien possesses “exceptional ability.” However, the Department has determined that it better serves and protects U.S. workers to first have employers seeking to employ aliens under current Schedule A Group II conduct a labor market test, with the CO assessing the employer's consideration of U.S. workers, and then allow DHS to make the “exceptional ability” determination, if the employer pursues an Immigrant Petition.
即使劳工部未采纳其拟将第656.15条全部内容删除并保留该条款编号的提案,第656.15条中仍将删除部分法规文本,这与劳工部旨在删除涉及超出其管辖范围主题的法规文本的目标相一致。例如,现行第656.15(c)条和第656.15(d)条列出了随I-140申请一并提交美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)的文件,供USCIS评估外国人是否具备所需杰出能力之用。DHS在其第8 CFR 204.5(k)(3)(ii)条法规中规定了供USCIS评估杰出能力所需的文件要求。往好处说,若劳工部法规第656.15(c)条和(d)条与DHS的法规存在差异,则会造成混淆。往坏处说,它们会妨碍USCIS评估杰出能力主张的能力。随着拟删除第656.15(c)条和(d)条的内容,USCIS第8 CFR 204.5(k)(3)(ii)条法规将明确地,且唯一地,适用。
Even if the Department does not adopt its proposal to delete the content of section 656.15 in its entirety and reserve the section, some regulatory text would be deleted from 656.15, consistent with the Department's goal of eliminating regulatory text covering topics outside the scope of the Department's jurisdiction. For example, current sections 656.15(c) and 656.15(d) list documentation to be submitted to USCIS with the I-140 petition, for use in USCIS' assessment of whether the alien possesses the requisite exceptional ability. DHS addresses documentation requirements for USCIS' assessment of exceptional ability in its regulations at 8 CFR 204.5(k)(3)(ii). At best, sections 656.15(c) and (d) of the Department's regulations create confusion to the extent there are differences between those sections and DHS' regulations. At worst, they hamper USCIS' ability to assess exceptional ability claims. With the proposed elimination of section 656.15(c) and (d) content, USCIS' regulations at 8 CFR 204.5(k)(3)(ii) would clearly—and solely—govern.
尽管部分雇主在雇用外国人时可能依赖附表A以减轻负担(即避免与提交申请前招募程序以及外国劳工认证办公室(OFLC)对永久雇用认证申请的审查程序相关的时间和成本负担),但劳工部同时认定,此种依赖利益并不超过劳工部在严格遵守《移民与国籍法》要求以及国会保护美国工人工资和工作条件之授权方面所具有的利益。
While some employers may have relied on Schedule A to reduce burden when hiring aliens ( i.e., avoiding time and cost burden associated with pre-filing recruitment and OFLC's Application for Permanent Employment Certification review process), the Department also has determined that this reliance interest does not outweigh the Department's interest in rigorous adherence to the requirements of the INA and Congress' mandate to protect the wages and working conditions of U.S. workers.
因此,劳工部主张,应当对这些工作机会进行劳动力市场测试,以履行劳工部在《移民与国籍法》(INA)项下的义务。劳工部在运用现行第656.24(b)(2)(ii)条规定的“同等合格”标准评估美国工人可获得性方面积累了经验,该标准目前适用于学院或大学教师职位的申请前招聘。在本规则中,如下文所述,劳工部提议扩大第656.24(b)(2)(ii)条的适用范围,使其涵盖声称具有科学或艺术领域杰出能力的外国人所获提供的工作机会的申请前招聘,并取消时间表A第II组。根据本拟议规则,雇主应当在《永久就业证明申请书》中将该工作机会标明为提供给声称具有杰出能力的外国人。雇主应当依照拟议第656.17条的要求开展申请前招聘,并编制招聘报告及其他所有能够证明符合拟议第656.17(f)条要求的佐证文件,随《永久就业证明申请书》一并提交。外国劳工证明办公室(OFLC)将审查雇主依据第656.17条开展的申请前招聘活动及其招聘结果,以评估是否存在至少与该外国人同等合格的美国工人。但是,OFLC将不会评估该外国人是否符合以杰出能力取得EB-2移民签证类别资格的条件,该项认定属于美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)的职责范围。如果雇主提交I-140表格《移民申请书》,主张依EB-2移民签证类别具有杰出能力,而USCIS依照国土安全部(DHS)相关法规,即8 CFR 204.5(k)条的要求,认定该外国人的资格未达到杰出能力的标准并予以拒绝,则雇主可以在不主张杰出能力的情况下,重新提交一份新的《永久就业证明申请书》。
Therefore, the Department asserts that a labor market test should be conducted for these job opportunities to satisfy the Department's obligations under the INA. The Department has experience assessing U.S. worker availability using the “equally qualified” standard of current section 656.24(b)(2)(ii), which the Department applies to pre-filing recruitment for college and university teacher positions. In this rule, as discussed below, the Department proposes to expand section 656.24(b)(2)(ii) to encompass pre-filing recruitment for job opportunities offered to aliens claimed to have exceptional ability in the sciences or the arts and eliminate Schedule A, Group II. Under this proposed rule, the employer would identify the job opportunity on the Application for Permanent Employment Certification as offered to an alien of claimed exceptional ability. The employer would conduct pre-filing recruitment following the requirements of proposed section 656.17 and prepare a recruitment report and all other supporting documentation demonstrating compliance with the requirements of proposed section 656.17(f) for submission with its Application for Permanent Employment Certification. OFLC would review the employer's pre-filing recruitment activities conducted pursuant to 656.17 and those recruitment results to assess the availability of U.S. workers at least as qualified as the alien. However, OFLC would not assess whether the alien qualifies for the EB-2 immigrant visa classification as an alien of exceptional ability; that determination resides with USCIS. If the employer files a Form I-140 Petition asserting exceptional ability under the EB-2 immigrant visa classification, and USCIS denies it after determining the alien's qualifications do not rise to the level of exceptional ability pursuant to the requirements in the relevant DHS regulations at 8 CFR 204.5(k), the employer could file a new Application for Permanent Employment Certification without the assertion of exceptional ability.
因此,劳工部提议取消现行第656.5条中关于第I组的时间表A规定,以及第656.15条相关条款中的对应规定,并在其他必要之处一并取消。目前被现行时间表A第I组涵盖的外国人,若雇主拟永久雇用此类外国人,须遵循标准的永久劳工证明(PERM)程序,包括拟议第656.17条规定的申请前招聘要求、拟议第656.10条规定的申请提交须知、拟议第656.19条规定的处理要求,以及适用于所有其他职业且无一例外的全部其他PERM法规要求。(第73936页印刷版)根据法律规定,针对此前归类于时间表A第II组的工作机会所提交的招聘报告及其他所有佐证文件,将依照第656.24(b)(2)(ii)条进行评估,该标准与适用于学院或大学教师《永久就业证明申请书》的标准相同;而针对此前归类于时间表A第I组的工作机会所提交的招聘报告,将依照适用于所有其他职业的第656.24(b)(2)(i)条进行评估。[59]劳工部指出,声称在商业领域具有杰出能力的外国人目前并未列于时间表A第II组,亦未列于8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(5)(A)(ii)条所规定的、确立第656.24(b)(2)(ii)条所述美国工人可获得性替代评估方法的法定条款之中;此类工作机会的招聘结果将继续适用第656.24(b)(2)(i)条进行评估。
As a result, the Department is proposing to eliminate Schedule A for Group I, both at the current section 656.5, in related provisions at section 656.15, and elsewhere as necessary. Employers seeking to permanently employ aliens currently covered in Group I of the current Schedule A would follow the standard PERM labor certification process, including the pre-filing recruitment requirements of ( printed page 73936) proposed section 656.17, the filing instructions of proposed section 656.10, the processing requirements of proposed section 656.19, and all other PERM regulatory requirements that apply to all other occupations, without exception. As required by statute, a recruitment report and all other supporting documentation submitted for a job opportunity formerly classified under Schedule A, Group II, will be assessed under section 656.24(b)(2)(ii), using the same standard as that which applies to Applications for Permanent Employment Certification for college or university teachers, while a recruitment report for a job opportunity formerly classified under Schedule A, Group I, will be assessed under section 656.24(b)(2)(i), which applies to all other occupations.[59] The Department notes that aliens claiming to have exceptional ability in business are not currently listed in Schedule A, Group II, or in the statutory provision at 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(5)(A)(ii), which establishes the alternative assessment for U.S. worker availability at section 656.24(b)(2)(ii); recruitment results for such job opportunities would continue to be subject to section 656.24(b)(2)(i).
鉴于上述情况,劳工部提议取消将现行第656.5条第II组所界定的具有杰出能力的外国人,归入时间表A这一总括性定义之下的规定。目前被现行时间表A第II组涵盖的外国人,若雇主拟永久雇用此类外国人,须遵循标准的永久劳工证明(PERM)程序(即拟议第656.10条、第656.17条和第656.19条,以及适用于所有其他职业的全部其他PERM法规要求);但是,根据《移民与国籍法》(INA)的要求,目前归属于第II组案件所提交的招聘报告,将依照第656.24(b)(2)(ii)条进行评估,采用与适用于学院或大学教师《永久就业证明申请书》相同的标准。[60]
In light of the foregoing, the Department proposes to eliminate the provision that classifies aliens of exceptional ability, defined in Group II of current section 656.5, under the umbrella definition of Schedule A. Employers seeking to permanently employ aliens currently covered in Group II of the current Schedule A would follow the standard PERM labor certification process ( i.e., proposed sections 656.10, 656.17, and 656.19, and all other PERM regulatory requirements that apply to all other occupations); however, the recruitment report submitted for a case currently covered in Group II will be assessed under section 656.24(b)(2)(ii), as required by the INA, using the same standard that applies to Applications for Permanent Employment Certification for college or university teachers.[60]
由于劳工部已确定无需对附表A下的第一组或第二组进行分类，并提议删除这些规定，劳工部进一步提议全文删除第656部分B分章现行第656.5节。劳工部的提议将导致B分章不包含任何监管条款，因此劳工部提议将现行第656部分B分章全部保留，以供未来制定规则时使用。
As the Department has determined that there is no need to classify either Group I or Group II under Schedule A and is proposing to delete these provisions, the Department further proposes the deletion of the current section 656.5 of part 656, subpart B in its entirety. The Department's proposal would result in subpart B not containing any regulatory sections, so the Department proposes to reserve current part 656, subpart B in full for future rulemaking.
取消附表A将使劳工部能够更好地确保美国工人有机会申请现有的工作机会，并遵守国会在《移民与国籍法》(INA)项下旨在保护分配给其的美国工人的法定要求。
The elimination of Schedule A would enable the Department to better ensure that U.S. workers have an opportunity to apply for available job opportunities, and adhere to the statutory requirements to protect U.S. workers assigned to it, as intended by Congress under the INA.
D. 关于对20 CFR第656部分C分章拟议修订的讨论
D. Discussion of Proposed Revisions to 20 CFR Part 656, Subpart C
在C分章中，劳工部提议在20 CFR第656.13节和第656.14节新增两个条款。劳工部还提议删除现行第656.15节和第656.16节中包含的内容，以便将其保留。根据本拟议规则，C分章的若干条款将予以保留，但会被重新调整用途和/或修订，具体讨论如下。
In subpart C, the Department proposes adding two new sections at 20 CFR 656.13 and 656.14. The Department is also proposing to delete the language currently contained in sections 656.15 and 656.16, so they can be reserved. Under this proposed rule, several sections of subpart C would be retained but repurposed and/or revised, as discussed below.
1. 拟议的20 CFR第656.10节，申请提交要求
1. Proposed 20 CFR 656.10, Application Filing Requirements
劳工部提议通过按处理阶段（而非按职业）重组永久性劳工认证(PERM)计划的监管框架，部分地明确提交永久性就业认证申请的流程。这种方法与劳工部现行的H-2A和H-2B临时劳工认证计划规定相一致，并将有助于明确和简化PERM劳工认证计划的规定。[61] 本着这一重组方式，劳工部提议将永久性就业认证申请的提交要求集中规定在第656.10节中，具体讨论如下。此外，劳工部提议对提交时所需的信息和文件做出某些更改，并根据本规则制定过程中的其他提议对监管语言进行修改。第656.10节中拟议的提交要求将适用于所有寻求永久雇用需要PERM劳工认证的工作机会中外国人的雇主，无论其职业为何。这些拟议的变更说明如下。
The Department proposes to clarify the process for filing an Application for Permanent Employment Certification, in part, by reorganizing the PERM labor certification program's regulatory framework to reflect program requirements by processing stage, rather than by occupation. This approach is consistent with the Department's existing H-2A and H-2B temporary labor certification program regulations and will help clarify and simplify the PERM labor certification program regulations.[61] In keeping with this reorganizational approach, the Department proposes to centralize the filing requirements for Applications for Permanent Employment Certification at section 656.10, as discussed below. In addition, the Department proposes certain changes to the information and documentation required at the time of filing and modifications to regulatory language in conformity with other proposals in this rulemaking. The filing requirements proposed in section 656.10 would apply to all employers seeking to permanently employ an alien in a job opportunity that requires a PERM labor certification, regardless of occupation. These proposed changes are explained below.
为实现第656.10节提交要求的集中规定，劳工部提议将若干段落移出及移入第656.10节。拟议规则将把现行第(b)段（代理）、第(c)段（声明）和第(d)段（通知）移出第656.10节，因为它们涉及的是提交要求以外的主题。这些段落的内容将被转移并在拟议规则的其他条款中处理，包括第656.3节、第656.4(b)节、第656.5(b)节、第656.13节和第656.14节。根据拟议规则，将移入修订后第656.10节的监管内容包括目前规定于以下各节的内容：第656.17(c)节（提交日期）；第656.17(l)节（与外国人对工作机会的影响有关的文件）；以及第656.19(b)节（住家家政服务工人的文件）。经过这些组织结构上的调整后，拟议的第656.10节将仅聚焦于提交要求，并将同时处理与之相关的提交日期、不完整申请的提交以及记录保存等主题。
To accomplish the centralization of filing requirements in section 656.10, the Department proposes to move paragraphs both out of and into section 656.10. The proposed rule would move the current paragraphs (b) (representation), (c) (attestations), and (d) (notice) out of section 656.10, as they address topics other than filing requirements. The content of these paragraphs would be relocated and addressed in other sections of the proposed rule, including sections 656.3, 656.4(b), 656.5(b), 656.13, and 656.14. Under the proposed rule, regulatory content that would move into revised section 656.10 include language currently provided for under: sections 656.17(c) (filing date); 656.17(l) (documentation related to alien influence over the job opportunity); and 656.19(b) (documentation for live-in household domestic service workers). Following these organizational changes, proposed section 656.10 will focus only on filing requirements and will also address the related topics of filing date, submission of incomplete applications, and record retention.
具体而言,在第656.10条拟议的(a)款(应提交的内容)和(d)款(原始签名)中,劳工部说明了所有雇主须向外国劳工认证办公室(OFLC)提交的内容。与现行做法一致,拟议的第656.10(a)(1)条和第656.10(d)条将要求雇主提交一份完整的、带有原始签名的永久就业证明申请书[62],其中须包括根据第656.40条[63]事先取得的现行工资确定(Prevailing Wage Determination,简称PWD),以及所有其他必填字段中提供的信息。拟议的第656.10(a)(1)条强调了必须在永久就业证明申请书(印刷版第73937页)中提供的若干关键雇主信息(即法定名称、商号名称、有效的联邦雇主识别号(FEIN)、在美国境内的有效营业场所[实际地址],以及潜在美国申请人可据以联系雇主以寻求就业的方式)。在现行规则中,第656.3条对“雇主”的定义要求雇主须拥有FEIN,并拥有“美国工人可被转介就业的美国境内地点”,ETA-9089表格及其填表说明将上述内容连同雇主名称、商号名称(如适用)及雇主联系信息列为必填项。为更清楚地表明此类关键雇主信息须在申请提交时提供(通过表格必填字段收集),劳工部提议将此内容纳入拟议的第656.10(a)(1)条,并在拟议的第656.10(a)(1)条中增加法定名称、商号名称以及潜在美国申请人可据以联系雇主以寻求就业的方式等内容,以与表格必填字段及H-2A项目法规保持一致。[64]如果雇主不使用商号名称,则须以“N/A”作为明确答复,这与现行表格填表说明一致。
Specifically, in proposed paragraphs (a) (What to file) and (d) (Original signature) of section 656.10, the Department addresses what all employers would be required to submit to OFLC. Consistent with current practice, proposed sections 656.10(a)(1) and 656.10(d) would require the employer to submit a complete Application for Permanent Employment Certification with original signature(s) [62] that includes a PWD obtained in advance pursuant to section 656.40 [63] and information provided in all other required fields. Proposed section 656.10(a)(1) highlights certain key employer information that must be provided ( i.e., legal name(s), trade name(s), valid FEIN, valid place of business [physical location] in the United States, and a means by which prospective U.S. applicants may contact the employer for employment) on the Application for Permanent Employment ( printed page 73937) Certification. In the current rule, the definition of Employer in section 656.3 requires the employer to have a FEIN and “a location within the United States to which U.S. workers may be referred for employment” and the Form ETA-9089 and instructions identify those, plus employer name, trade name (if applicable), and contact information for the employer, as required. To improve clarity that this key employer information is required at the time of filing—collected through required form fields—the Department proposes to include this content in proposed section 656.10(a)(1) and add legal name, trade name(s), and means by which prospective U.S. applicants may contact the employer for employment to proposed section 656.10(a)(1), consistent with required form fields and H-2A program regulations.[64] If the employer does not use a trade name, “N/A” as an affirmative response is required, consistent with current form instructions.
在拟议的第656.10(a)(2)款至(4)款中,劳工部提议增加雇主须与永久就业证明申请书同时提交的其他记录和文件。该提案将改变雇主向OFLC提交证明其已就招聘事宜通知并考虑美国工人的记录和文件的时间安排及提交频率。
In proposed sections 656.10(a)(2) through (4), the Department proposes additional records and documentation that employers must submit concurrently with the Application for Permanent Employment Certification. The proposal would change both the timing and frequency of employers' submission to OFLC of records and documentation demonstrating compliance with its notice to and consideration of U.S. workers.
就与招聘相关的文件而言,现行规则要求雇主保留记录和文件副本,以证明其遵守提交申请前的招聘要求(例如,广告副本以及申请该职位空缺的美国工人的简历),并保留一份招聘报告,说明已采取的招聘步骤及所取得的结果,包括未录用任何申请该职位的美国工人的合法、与工作相关的原因。参见现行第656.10(f)条和第656.17(g)(1)条。现行规则不要求雇主向国家处理中心(NPC)提交此类文件,除非经签证官(Certifying Officer,简称CO)要求。
For recruitment-related documentation, the current rule requires that employers retain copies of records and documentation to show compliance with pre-filing recruitment requirements ( e.g., copies of advertisements and resumes for U.S. workers who applied for the job opportunity) and a recruitment report describing the recruitment steps undertaken and the results achieved, including the lawful, job-related reason for not hiring any of the U.S. workers who applied. See current sections 656.10(f) and 656.17(g)(1). The current rule does not require employers to submit this documentation to the NPC, unless requested by the CO.
同样,根据现行规则,雇主须准备并保留其向雇员发出的有关提交永久就业证明申请书的通知的证明,该通知可通过谈判代表发出或以向雇员张贴通知的方式发出,并须保留有关如何就该申请联系劳工部(DOL)的信息。参见现行第656.10(d)条和(f)条。对于不适用监督招聘程序的雇主,雇主须在提交永久就业证明申请书之前提供或张贴申请提交通知(Notice of Filing,简称NOF),并保留相关证明,以备在CO要求时提交。如果CO在申请处理期间要求实施监督招聘,CO可命令雇主根据CO所命令的补充广告内容更新NOF中的修订信息。
Similarly, employers prepare and retain evidence of the notice they provide to employees of the filing of the Application for Permanent Employment Certification —through bargaining representative(s) or posted notice to employees—and information about contacting DOL with information about the application, under the current rule. See current sections 656.10(d) and (f). For employers not subject to supervised recruitment, the employer provides or posts the NOF before filing the Application for Permanent Employment Certification and retains evidence of it for submission, upon request by the CO. If the CO imposes supervised recruitment during application processing, the CO may order the employer to update the NOF with revised information, consistent with the CO's ordered content for additional advertising.
对于在现行规则下提交未来永久就业证明申请时需接受监督招聘的雇主,认证官(CO)指示雇主不得提供或张贴招聘通知(NOF),直至认证官有机会在监督招聘过程中对其内容连同广告内容予以核准。尽管这一做法可确保招聘通知内容准确无误,但劳工部已确定,将招聘通知的张贴推迟至永久就业证明申请提交之后的做法有违法律规定,因为法律要求招聘通知须在申请提交之时发布。[65]即便最初张贴的招聘通知所载信息不完善,且认证官在监督招聘期间责令雇主予以修订,申请提交前的招聘通知也能告知雇员该雇主正在提交永久就业证明申请,并确保雇员有机会就招聘通知中所述工作机会向劳工部提供信息或提出关切。拟议规则将要求在所有情形下,向谈判代表发出通知或张贴招聘通知须在雇主提交永久就业证明申请前10个工作日内开始。参见拟议第656.10(a)(2)条和第656.14(f)条。
For employers subject to supervised recruitment when filing future Applications for Permanent Employment Certification under the current rule, the CO instructs the employer not to provide or post the NOF until the CO has an opportunity to approve its content, along with advertising content, during the supervised recruitment process. While this practice ensures the NOF contains correct information, the Department has determined that delaying NOF posting until after filing the Application for Permanent Employment Certification is contrary to statute, which requires NOF at the time of filing.[65] Even if the initial NOF posted contains imperfect information, which the CO orders the employer to revise during supervised recruitment, the pre-filing NOF informs employees that the employer is filing an Application for Permanent Employment Certification and ensures that employees have an opportunity to provide information or concerns to DOL about the job opportunity described in the NOF. The proposed rule would require the notice to the bargaining representative(s) or NOF posting to begin within 10 business days before the employer files the Application for Permanent Employment Certification in all cases. See proposed sections 656.10(a)(2) and 656.14(f).
劳工部还拟在拟议第656.21(c)(7)条中增加说明性语言,以告知须接受监督招聘的雇主,认证官可能要求其在办理过程中以修订后的内容更新招聘通知。
The Department also proposes to add clarifying language in proposed section 656.21(c)(7) to put employers subject to supervised recruitment on notice that the CO may require them to update the NOF during processing with revised content.
此外,拟议第656.10(a)(2)条将要求所有雇主在提交永久就业证明申请的同时,提交证明其遵守招聘通知要求的文件。同样,拟议第656.10(a)(3)条和第(4)条将要求雇主在提交永久就业证明申请的同时,提交证明其遵守所有提交前招聘要求的文件和记录,包括申请该工作机会的美国工人提交的简历和申请材料。[66]
In addition, proposed section 656.10(a)(2) would require all employers to submit documentation demonstrating their compliance with NOF requirements concurrently with the Application for Permanent Employment Certification. Similarly, proposed sections 656.10(a)(3) and (4) would require employers to submit documents and records evidencing compliance with all pre-filing recruitment requirements, including resumes and applications for U.S. workers who applied for the job opportunity, concurrently with the Application for Permanent Employment Certification.[66]
要求在作出PERM劳工证明决定之前提交招聘通知、招聘活动及结果的文件记录以及招聘报告,将在对负担造成轻微影响的情况下,增强雇主为善意测试国内劳动力市场所作努力的透明度,并强化项目诚信工作。此外,该拟议变更将加强对雇主遵守项目要求的激励,并确保劳工部的最终裁定更频繁地建立在缺乏合格美国工人的实际证据基础之上。目前,尽管所有雇主均须准备并保存此类文件,但仅部分雇主须在认证官作出最终裁定前将其提交至国家处理中心(NPC)。根据现行规则,在绝大多数情形下,认证官在未审查雇主对美国工人考量情况的情形下即核准申请,仅依赖雇主的声明。按照拟议规则,认证官可自行决定在作出最终裁定前审查部分或全部招聘报告。若招聘报告引发有关雇主是否遵守招聘要求或是否对美国工人予以考量的疑虑,认证官可审查相关支持文件(例如,广告副本、美国工人的简历和申请材料),以进一步评估雇主发布该工作机会广告的内容、地点和时间,以及其对申请或被推荐该工作机会的美国工人的考量情况,而无需进行不必要的函件往来或使该申请接受全面审计审查。因此,劳工部预计,对这些现成文件的额外审查将使认证官能够基于证据而非声明作出最终裁定,且不增加额外的办理程序。例如,若雇主的广告中所列工资报价低于或所需资格高于永久就业证明申请(第73938页)中所注明的内容,则该申请可据此予以拒绝,而无需经过更冗长的审计审查程序。
Requiring submission of the NOF, documentation of recruitment activity and results, and the recruitment report prior to the issuance of a PERM labor certification decision will enhance transparency about the employer's efforts to conduct a good faith test of the domestic labor market and bolster program integrity efforts, with minor impact to burden. Further, the proposed change would strengthen the incentives for employers to comply with program requirements and ensure the Department's final determinations are more frequently based on actual evidence of a lack of qualified U.S. workers. While currently all employers must prepare and retain this documentation, only some employers are required to submit it to the NPC before the CO issues a final determination. Under the current rule, the CO certifies applications in the vast majority of circumstances without having reviewed the employer's consideration of U.S. workers; the CO relies on the employer's attestations alone. As proposed, the CO has discretion to review some or all recruitment reports prior to issuance of a final determination. In the event a recruitment report raised concerns regarding the employer's compliance with recruitment requirements or consideration of U.S. workers, the CO could review the supporting documentation ( e.g., copies of advertisements, U.S. worker resumes and applications) to further assess the content, location, and timing of the employer's advertising of the job opportunity and its consideration of the U.S. workers who applied or were referred for the job opportunity, without unnecessary correspondence or subjecting the application for full audit examination. Thus, the Department expects that this additional review of readily-available documents will enable the CO to reach a final determination based on evidence, as opposed to attestations, without additional processing. For example, if the employer's advertisements included a lower wage offer or higher qualifications than indicated on the Application for ( printed page 73938) Permanent Employment Certification, the application could be denied on that basis without a lengthier audit examination process.
劳工部还希望强调,雇主本已被要求编制申请通知(NOF)和招聘报告,并连同证明文件一并保存副本,以便应认证官(CO)的要求提供。因此,除雇主在提交申请时将该文件上传至FLAG系统所产生的负担外,拟议的要求变更不会产生任何额外负担。劳工部认为,这构成一项微小负担,所导致的负担增加可忽略不计。
The Department also would like to emphasize that employers are already required to prepare the NOF and recruitment reports and maintain copies of them, along with supporting documentation, to be provided to the CO upon request, so no additional burden would result from the proposed change to the requirements beyond the burden associated with uploading that documentation in the FLAG system at the time the employer files the application, which, in the Department's opinion, constitutes a de minimis burden that results in a negligible burden increase.
此外,本提案将提高劳工部各临时性和永久性劳工认证项目之间的一致性,同时兼顾各项目之间的差异,并提升处理效率。例如,与H-2B和CW-1临时劳工认证项目类似,本提案将要求雇主在认证官作出最终决定之前提交招聘报告,供认证官审查。[67]然而,鉴于所需招聘活动完成的时间点不同,招聘报告在最终决定作出前提交的时间安排也会有所不同,即PERM劳工认证项目要求在提交申请前完成招聘活动,而H-2B和CW-1项目则是在申请审查期间完成招聘活动。由于招聘活动及最终招聘报告必须在提交申请前完成,要求雇主在提交永久就业认证申请时一并提交招聘报告,属于适当的项目差异化安排,有助于实现劳工部提升处理效率的目标。按照PERM劳工认证项目的拟议规定,认证官将能够在作出最终决定之前审查雇主的申请通知(NOF)和招聘报告及相关证明文件,而无需进行额外且不必要的往来函件。
In addition, this proposal would increase consistency across the Department's temporary and permanent labor certification programs, while accommodating program differences and supporting processing efficiency. For example, similar to the H-2B and CW-1 temporary labor certification programs, this proposal would require submission of the employer's recruitment report for CO review before the CO issues a final determination.[67] However, the timing of recruitment report submission before final determination would be different, based on when required recruitment activities are completed—pre-filing for the PERM labor certification program and during application review for the H-2B and CW-1 programs. Because recruitment—and a final recruitment report—must be completed pre-filing, requiring submission of the employer's recruitment report at the time of filing the Application for Permanent Employment Certification is an appropriate programmatic difference, which furthers the Department's processing efficiency goals. As proposed for the PERM labor certification program, the CO would be able to review employers' NOFs and recruitment reports—and related supporting documentation—before reaching final determinations without additional, unnecessary correspondence.
申请提交的及时性
Timeliness for Filing
劳工部在拟议第656.10(b)条中提议,就向外国劳工认证办公室(OFLC)提交永久就业认证申请设定单一的提交时限要求。雇主须在完成所有提交前招聘要求后30个日历日内,提交完整的永久就业认证申请,并附上提交时要求的所有文件和信息。结合拟议第656.17(d)条的规定,这意味着雇主必须在预计提交永久就业认证申请前的第30至第60个日历日之间完成全部招聘活动,然后在最后一项招聘活动结束后的第1至第29个日历日之间提交申请。该30日时限要求将同时适用于依照拟议第656.17条规定从事提交前招聘程序的雇主,以及依照拟议第656.18条规定就大学和学院教师或职业运动员及职业运动队教练从事可选提交前招聘程序的雇主。目前,依照第656.17条提交申请的雇主须在开始提交前招聘活动及张贴申请通知(NOF)后的180个日历日内提交申请,而依照第656.18条提交申请的雇主则须在外国人被选定后18个月内提交申请,而这一时间点往往比实际提交申请的时间早许多个月。[68]
The Department is proposing a single filing timeframe requirement for submission of Applications for Permanent Employment Certification to OFLC in proposed section 656.10(b). An employer would be required to submit the complete Application for Permanent Employment Certification, with all documentation and information required at the time of filing, within 30 calendar days after the employer completes all pre-filing recruitment requirements. Together with proposed section 656.17(d), this would mean an employer must complete all recruitment activities between 30 to 60 calendar days before the employer expects to file the Application for Permanent Employment Certification and then file the application between 1 and 29 calendar days after the last recruitment activity ends. This 30-day timing requirement would apply to both employers who engage in the pre-filing recruitment procedures set forth in proposed section 656.17 and employers who engage in the optional pre-filing recruitment procedures for college and university teachers or professional athletes and professional sports team coaches set forth in proposed section 656.18. Currently, employers filing under section 656.17 must submit the application within 180 calendar days of beginning pre-filing recruitment activities and NOF posting, while employers filing under section 656.18 must do so within 18 months of the alien's selection, which is often many months before the actual filing of the application.[68]
劳工部提出此申请时限变更,旨在简化第656部分规定,并更好地向发证官(CO)提供有关美国工人是否可获得从事永久就业证明申请所涉工作机会的最新信息。根据现行规则,雇主的招聘工作及招聘结果可能在雇主提交永久就业证明申请之前即已过时。劳工部认为,现行第656.17条和第656.18条分别规定的180个日历日和18个月的时限,长于雇主在完成申请前招聘要求后准备招聘报告所必需的时间。劳工部认为,拟议的在完成申请前招聘后30天的时限,是为随永久就业证明申请一并提交而准备招聘报告的合理期限,且该等招聘报告将向发证官提供有关美国工人当前可获得性的更佳信息。此外,按照拟议规定,雇主将在更接近劳动力市场测试的时间内提交永久就业证明申请,这将确保可能有意从事该工作机会的美国工人在更接近永久就业证明申请提交之时获知该职位信息,而非提前数月获知,并确保提供给发证官的招聘报告反映当前的劳动力市场结果。
The Department proposes this filing timeframe change to simplify part 656 and better provide the CO with more current information about the availability of U.S. workers for job opportunities that are the subject of an Application for Permanent Employment Certification. Under the current rule, an employer's recruitment and recruitment results can become stale before the employer submits its Application for Permanent Employment Certification. The Department considers the current timeframes—180 calendar days and 18 months in current sections 656.17 and 656.18, respectively—longer than necessary to enable employers to prepare their recruitment reports after completing pre-filing recruitment requirements. The Department considers the proposed 30-day timeframe after completion of pre-filing recruitment to be a reasonable period for preparation of recruitment reports for submission with the Application for Permanent Employment Certification and those recruitment reports would provide better information about the current availability of U.S. workers to the CO. In addition, as proposed, employers would file the Application for Permanent Employment Certification in closer proximity to the labor market test, which would ensure that U.S. workers who may have availability for the job opportunity are made aware of the job in closer proximity to the filing of the Application for Permanent Employment Certification, rather than many months ahead of time, and the recruitment report provided to the CO reflects current labor market results.
劳工部欢迎就拟议的申请时限要求提出意见,该要求符合劳工部简化第656部分规定、确保招聘活动及招聘结果报告在提交国家处理中心(NPC)时不致过时的目标。劳工部特别欢迎就以下问题提出意见:对于依据拟议第656.18条规定的竞争性招聘与遴选程序提交的永久就业证明申请,30天时限要求应以最后一次广告刊登日期为基准,还是以组织或行政机构作出推荐或遴选外国人之最终报告的日期为基准。参见拟议第656.18(a)(2)条。
The Department invites comments on the proposed filing timeframe requirement that is consistent with the Department's goal of simplifying part 656 and ensuring recruitment activities and the report of recruitment results are not stale when submitted to the NPC. In particular, the Department invites comments about whether the 30-day timeliness requirement should be applied to Applications for Permanent Employment Certification filed using the proposed competitive recruitment and selection process of proposed section 656.18 based on the last advertisement date or the date of the organizational or administrative body's final report making the recommendation or selection of the alien. See proposed section 656.18(a)(2).
提交地点及方式
Location and Method of Filing
在第(c)款中,劳工部提议要求提交给外国劳工认证办公室(OFLC)的永久就业证明申请一律采用电子提交方式,但在有限情形下除外。对于目前使用劳工部FLAG系统(网址:https://flag.dol.gov/)提交永久就业证明申请的雇主而言,本提案并不构成变更。FLAG仍为外国劳工认证办公室局长指定的永久就业证明申请电子提交方式。与劳工部在临时劳工认证项目中强制实行电子提交时所采取的做法一致,劳工部提议在永久劳工认证(PERM)项目中,依据第(c)(2)款和第(c)(3)款采取类似程序,雇主可通过向外国劳工认证办公室局长证明其无法使用或接入电子提交系统,或在使用或接入方面受到限制,从而申请获准以邮寄方式提交申请。雇主可以书面方式联系国家处理中心(NPC),地址见《联邦公报》所刊登通知中指定的地址;听力或言语障碍人士可拨打1-877-889-5627(此为联邦信息中继服务免费听障专线)寻求协助,以使用、接入或提交本部分项下要求的任何表格或文件,包括永久就业证明申请。(印刷页第73939页)本提案,连同第656.40(a)(2)条中要求对现行工资裁定申请采用电子提交方式的相应提案,将使劳工部管理的外国劳工认证与劳工条件申请项目在程序上保持一致。若获通过,雇主将须通过FLAG系统以电子方式向外国劳工认证办公室提交所有申请,除非适用有限例外情形。
In paragraph (c), the Department proposes to require electronic filing for Applications for Permanent Employment Certification submitted to OFLC, except in limited circumstances. This proposal does not constitute a change for those employers who file Applications for Permanent Employment Certification using the Department's FLAG system, available at https://flag.dol.gov/​. FLAG continues to be the OFLC Administrator's designated electronic filing method for Applications for Permanent Employment Certification. Consistent with the Department's approach when mandating electronic filing in temporary labor certification programs, the Department proposes similar procedures in the PERM labor certification program under paragraphs (c)(2) and (3), through which an employer may request authorization to file by mail by demonstrating to the OFLC Administrator that they are unable or limited in their ability to use or access electronic filing. An employer may contact the NPC in writing to the address designated in a notice published in the Federal Register , or for individuals with hearing or speech impairments, 1-877-889-5627 (this is the TTY toll-free Federal Information Relay Service number) for assistance in using, accessing, or filing any form or documentation required under this part, including the Application for Permanent Employment Certification. ( printed page 73939) This proposal—and the parallel proposal in section 656.40(a)(2) to require electronic filing for Applications for Prevailing Wage Determination —would bring consistency across the foreign labor certification and labor condition application programs administered by the Department. If adopted, employers would submit all applications electronically to OFLC through the FLAG system, unless a limited exception applied.
根据管理永久性和临时性劳工证明项目的丰富经验,劳工部已确定,强制实行电子申请可降低大多数雇主及劳工部的成本(例如邮寄费用)和负担,减少申请提交相关延误的发生频率,提高所收集信息的质量,促进行政效率和问责制,并增强各劳工证明项目之间的一致性。对雇主及其授权代表而言,劳工部关于要求电子申请的提案将通过允许更迅速地处理申请、减轻文书负担和邮寄成本,改善客户体验。电子申请提供系统提示,包括就申请不完整或明显不准确发出警告,并为雇主提供立即纠正错误或上传缺失文件的机会。强制电子申请促进了劳工部与雇主及其代表之间沟通的效率。
Based on extensive experience administering permanent and temporary labor certification programs, the Department has determined that mandating electronic filing reduces costs ( e.g., mailing fees) and burdens for most employers and for the Department, reduces the frequency of delays related to filing applications, improves the quality of information collected, promotes administrative efficiency and accountability, and increases consistency across labor certification programs. For employers and their authorized representatives, the Department's proposal to require electronic filing would improve customer experience by permitting more prompt processing of applications and reducing paperwork burdens and mailing costs. Electronic filing provides system prompts, which include warnings that an application is incomplete or obviously inaccurate and provides employers with an immediate opportunity to correct the errors or upload the missing documentation. Mandatory electronic filing furthers efficiency in communications between the Department and the employer and its representatives.
劳工部预计,要求电子申请不会要求绝大多数雇主改变其做法。根据2021财年至2025财年(FY)的数据,约99.61%的永久劳工认证(PERM)劳工证明申请是以电子方式提交的。[69]在其余以邮寄方式提交申请的0.39%中,几乎所有申请在申请表上也披露了有效的电子邮件地址,这表明雇主及(如适用)其授权律师和代理人均可使用互联网,很可能能够以电子方式提交申请。
The Department anticipates that requiring e-filing will not require a change of practice for the vast majority of employers. Based on fiscal year (FY) 2021-FY 2025 data, approximately 99.61 percent of PERM labor certification applications were filed electronically.[69] Almost all of the remaining 0.39 percent of PERM labor certification applications filed by mail also disclosed valid email addresses on the application form, thereby suggesting that employers and, if applicable, their authorized attorneys and agents have access to the internet and are likely capable of filing electronically.
某些申请所需的额外文件
Additional Documentation Required for Certain Applications
如下文所述,在删除现行第(e)段的内容后,劳工部提议将第(e)段重新用于处理某些工作机会的额外文件要求。劳工部提议将现行第656.19(b)条(住家家庭佣工的文件)和第656.17(l)条(与外籍人员对工作机会的影响相关的文件)的内容分别移至拟议的第656.10(e)(1)条和第656.10(e)(2)条,并在拟议的第656.10(e)(3)条中新增监管内容,以将现行做法予以成文化(作细微修改),适用于寻求永久雇用符合第656.3条所规定定义的职业运动员或职业运动队教练的雇主。
After eliminating the content of current paragraph (e), as discussed below, the Department proposes to repurpose paragraph (e) to address additional documentation requirements for certain job opportunities. The Department proposes to relocate the content of current sections 656.19(b) (documentation for live-in household domestic service workers) and 656.17(l) (documentation related to alien influence over the job opportunity) to proposed sections 656.10(e)(1) and (e)(2), respectively, and add new regulatory content in proposed section 656.10(e)(3) to codify, with minor changes, the current practice for employers seeking to permanently employ professional athletes or professional sports team coaches, who meet the definition set forth in section 656.3.
在将现行第656.19(b)条的内容移至拟议的第656.10(e)(1)条后,劳工部提议作出非实质性修改以提高可读性,并作出简化文件要求的修改,同时更好地确保雇佣合同充分披露有关所提供住家家庭佣工工作的所有相关信息。根据现行规则,雇主必须编制并保存一份说明家庭居住条件的声明,其中包含现行第656.19(b)(1)条所列信息,以及一份雇佣合同,其中包含现行第656.19(b)(2)条所列信息。拟议规则将取消单独的家庭居住条件说明,并将其所需内容移至雇佣合同中,从而形成一份包含所提供工作全部所需信息的文件。该提案简化了文件要求,同时更好地确保外籍人员知悉家庭居住条件信息。此外,拟议规则将减少雇主必须保存的雇佣合同份数。目前,寻求永久雇用外籍人员从事住家家庭佣工工作的雇主必须保存两份雇佣合同,但拟议规则仅要求保存一份。[70]
After relocating the content of current section 656.19(b) to proposed section 656.10(e)(1), the Department proposes non-substantive changes for readability and changes to simplify documentation, while better ensuring the employment contract fully discloses all appropriate information about live-in household domestic service jobs offered. Under the current rule, the employer must prepare and retain both a statement describing the household living accommodations, which contains the information listed in current section 656.19(b)(1), and an employment contract, which contains information listed in current section 656.19(b)(2). The proposed rule would eliminate the separate statement describing household living accommodations and relocate its required content to the employment contract, resulting in one document that contains all required information about the job offered. This proposal simplifies documentation requirements, while better ensuring that the alien is apprised of the household living accommodations information. In addition, the proposed rule would reduce the number of copies of the employment contract the employer must retain. Currently, an employer seeking to permanently employ an alien in a live-in household domestic service job opportunity must retain two copies of the employment contract, but the proposed rule would only require retention of one.[70]
该部门提议的第656.10(e)(1)(i)条删除了住家家政服务工作机会雇佣合同所要求内容中的两项关键信息(即现行第656.19(b)(2)(i)条和第656.19(b)(2)(v)条项下分别要求的工资待遇和职责说明)。但是,这两项信息仍然属于必要信息。提议的第656.10(e)(1)(i)条在引出列举清单之前的措辞规定,雇佣合同必须“至少包含在永久就业资格认证申请表中所列明的相同实质性雇佣条款,以及以下信息和雇佣保证”。通过要求雇佣合同包含与永久就业资格认证申请表相同的实质性雇佣条款,该部门不仅确保雇佣合同将继续包含工资待遇和职责说明,还确保其包含雇主在永久就业资格认证申请表中列明的任何其他实质性雇佣条款,而这些条款无法通过一份固定清单充分涵盖。此外,通过这种方式,该部门能够更好地确保雇佣合同包含所有必要信息,并与用于测试美国劳动力市场的永久就业资格认证申请表保持一致。
The Department's proposed section 656.10(e)(1)(i) eliminates two key pieces of information from the content required of employment contracts for live-in household domestic service job opportunity ( i.e., the wage offer and description of duties required under current section 656.19(b)(2)(i) and (v), respectively). However, the two pieces of information are still required. The proposed language that introduces the enumerated list in proposed section 656.10(e)(1)(i) states that the employment contract must “contain[ ], at a minimum, the same material terms of employment specified on the Application for Permanent Employment Certification and the following information and employment guarantees.” By requiring the employment contract to contain the same material terms of employment as the Application for Permanent Employment Certification, the Department ensures not only that the employment contract will continue to contain the wage offer and description of duties, but also any other material terms of employment the employer specified on the Application for Permanent Employment Certification, which could not be adequately captured in a static list. Moreover, through this approach, the Department would better ensure that the employment contract contains all essential information and is consistent with the Application for Permanent Employment Certification used to test the U.S. labor market.
提议的第656.10(e)(2)条保留了现行第656.17(l)条(外国人对工作机会的影响和控制)中关于补充文件要求的内容,仅作一项修改以消除重复表述从而简化规则,此外仅作与本提议规则通篇所用术语保持一致的微小修改。提议的第656.10(e)(2)条删除了现行第656.17(l)条中出现的短语“必须能够证明存在真实的工作机会,即该工作对所有美国工人均可获得”。该要求并非仅限于外国人拥有所有权权益的closely held公司或合伙企业所涉及的工作机会,也不限于股东、公司高管、发起人或合伙人与该外国人之间存在家庭关系的情形,或该外国人系少数雇员之一的情形。根据现行规则和拟议规则,该要求适用于所有永久就业资格认证申请表。现行规则在第656.10(c)(8)条以及第656.17(l)条中均规定了该要求,而拟议规则则在拟议的第656.13(a)条中规定了该要求。
Proposed section 656.10(e)(2) retains content of the additional documentation requirements found in current section 656.17(l) (Alien influence and control over job opportunity) with one change to simplify the rule by eliminating redundant language and, otherwise, only minor changes to conform with terminology used throughout this proposed rule. Proposed section 656.10(e)(2) eliminates the phrase “must be able to demonstrate the existence of a bona fide job opportunity, i.e., the job is available to all U.S. workers,” which appears in current section 656.17(l). This is not a requirement limited to job opportunities involving closely held corporations or partnerships in which the alien has an ownership interest; or familial relationships between the stockholders, corporate officers, incorporators, or partners, and the alien; or the alien as one of a small number of employees. It is a requirement applicable to all Applications for Permanent Employment Certification under both the current and proposed rules. The current rule addresses the requirement in section 656.10(c)(8) as well as section 656.17(l), while the proposed rule addresses this requirement in proposed section 656.13(a).
根据提议的第656.10(e)(3)条,为职业运动员或职业(印刷页码第73940页)运动队教练提交永久就业资格认证申请表的雇主,须按照长期以来的惯例编制并保存以下文件:(1)一份由雇主和外国人签字并注明日期的已签署书面合同副本,涵盖全年或相关期间,并载明向该外国人支付的具体款项;(2)一份雇佣信函,说明该外国人在休赛期每周至少工作十(10)小时;以及(3)对于因拟从事职业运动员永久性工作而被担保的外国人,须提供一份来自球员协会(例如NBA、NHL、NFL、MLB)或适用工会的信函或回复的副本,无论是电子形式还是纸质形式,表明该协会或工会已按照第656.14(a)(1)条的要求收到雇主的通知,且对提交永久就业资格认证申请表无异议。该部门认识到,球员协会和工会对雇主发出的通知以及要求确认“无异议”的请求的回应程度可能有所不同。该部门欢迎就以下问题提出意见:在球员协会或适用工会未作出回应的情况下,雇主是否以及如何能够证明其已遵守此项通知和请求要求。
Under proposed section 656.10(e)(3), employers filing Applications for Permanent Employment Certification for professional athletes or professional ( printed page 73940) sports team coaches would be required to prepare and maintain the following documentation, consistent with longstanding practice: (1) a copy of the executed written contract, signed and dated by the employer and alien, covering the entire year or period that indicates the specific payment(s) made to the alien; (2) an employment letter stating that the alien will work a minimum of ten (10) hours per week during the off-season period; and (3) for an alien being sponsored for permanent employment as a professional athlete, a copy of a letter or response, whether electronic or print, from the Players' Association ( e.g., NBA, NHL, NFL, MLB) or applicable trade union(s) stating that it was provided notice from the employer, as required by section 656.14(a)(1), and has no objection to the filing of the Application for Permanent Employment Certification. The Department recognizes that Players' Association and trade union(s) may vary in their responsiveness to an employer's notice and request for confirmation of “no objection” to the filing of an Application for Permanent Employment Certification. The Department invites comments about whether and how an employer could document compliance with this notice and request requirement, in the absence of a response from the Players' Association or applicable trade union(s).
该部门不建议改变提交此类补充文件的时间安排。根据拟议第656.10(e)条规定提交需满足补充文件要求之申请的雇主,将继续按要求准备补充文件并将其保留在记录保存档案中,仅在收到要求时才予提交。然而,通过将补充文件要求纳入拟议第656.10条,该部门明确,无论在现行规定下还是在拟议规则下,补充文件的准备和保存均属于申请提交要求的一部分,即该文件必须在提交永久就业证明申请时已经准备完毕并保存在雇主的记录保存档案中。此项变更不会给雇主带来任何新的负担。
The Department does not propose to change the timing of submission for this additional documentation. Employers filing applications subject to the additional documentation requirements under proposed section 656.10(e) would continue to prepare and maintain the additional documentation required for the job opportunity in their record retention file and only submit it upon request. However, by locating the additional documentation requirements in proposed section 656.10, the Department clarifies that—both currently and under the proposed rule—preparation and retention of the additional documentation is a filing requirement, meaning it must be prepared and already saved in the employer's record retention file at the time of Application for Permanent Employment Certification submission. No new burden would be incurred by employers as a result of this change.
提交日期
Filing Date
该部门建议将现行第656.17(c)条中的提交日期规定迁移至拟议第656.10(f)条的集中提交要求中,并作出相应修改,以与本规则中其他拟议监管变化保持一致。拟议条款继续将外国劳工认证办公室(OFLC)接受处理完整永久就业证明申请的日期视为“提交日期”。对于以电子方式提交的申请,“提交日期”是指申请在电子系统中提交并被接受的日期,以美国东部时区的接受时间为准。对于根据拟议第656.10(c)(2)款和(3)款规定的程序以邮寄方式提交的申请,“提交日期”将为雇主永久就业证明申请材料上所盖的邮戳日期,前提是国家处理中心(NPC)认定该申请完整。这对以邮寄方式提交的申请而言将构成一项变更。目前,提交日期是国家处理中心接受申请进行处理并在提交材料上加盖日期戳的日期。然而,现行做法不如以邮戳确定提交日期那样简单明了,且送达与加盖日期戳之间的延迟,已导致一些申请因不符合时间要求(例如,招聘日期须在提交日期前180日以内)而被拒绝,而这些拒绝后来被劳工部上诉委员会(BALCA)推翻。[71]为简便、高效和确定起见,该部门建议对以邮寄方式提交的完整申请,以邮戳日期作为提交日期。
The Department proposes to relocate the filing date provision currently in section 656.17(c) to the centralized filing requirements in proposed section 656.10(f), with modifications to conform with other proposed regulatory changes herein. The proposed paragraph continues to deem the date OFLC accepts for processing a complete Application for Permanent Employment Certification to be the “filing date.” For an electronically filed application, the “filing date” is the date the application is submitted and accepted in the electronic system based on the time of acceptance in the Eastern time zone of the United States. For an application submitted by mail under the procedures proposed at section 656.10(c)(2) and (3), the “filing date” would be the postmark date affixed to the employer's Application for Permanent Employment Certification submission, provided that the NPC determines the application is complete. This would be a change for applications submitted by mail. Currently, the filing date is the date the NPC accepts the application for processing and affixes a date stamp on the submission. However, the current approach is less straightforward than establishing the filing date using the postmark and delay between delivery and affixing a date stamp has resulted in denials for noncompliance with timing requirements ( e.g., recruitment dates within the 180 days prior to the filing date) that BALCA has overturned.[71] In the interest of simplicity, efficiency, and certainty, the Department proposes to use the postmark date as the filing date for complete applications submitted by mail.
完整性
Completeness
现行第656.17(a)(1)条规定,不完整的申请将被拒绝。在拟议第656.10(g)条中,该部门建议改为将不完整的申请原样退回雇主,不予处理。
Current section 656.17(a)(1) provides that incomplete applications will be denied. In the proposed section 656.10(g), the Department proposes, instead, to return incomplete applications to employers unprocessed.
根据拟议规则,完整的申请应包括:一份已完整填写所有必填栏位且信息有效的ETA-9089表格(永久就业证明申请表),一份有效的现行工资裁定(PWD),以及雇主针对该永久就业证明申请中所提供工作机会的招聘报告,具体如拟议第656.10(a)条所述。尽管表格说明和FLAG系统提示旨在确保雇主提交完整的永久就业证明申请,该部门仍会收到缺少必填信息的申请。该部门曾收到雇主绕开系统提示、填入无意义或占位信息的申请(例如,将雇主联系人填写为电影或卡通人物,或将“待定”或“测试对象”填写为外国人姓名),以此规避旨在确保只有完整有效申请才能提交的系统提示。该部门预计今后仍将继续收到此类申请,这会拖慢对那些出于真实用工需求而提交完整合规申请的雇主的审理进度。鉴于本规则拟将雇主的招聘报告及其他与招聘相关的文件新增为申请提交要求之一,该部门也预计,个别不诚实的雇主可能会试图通过在FLAG系统中上传并非真实招聘文件的其他材料,来同样规避系统审查。例如,若缺少有效的招聘报告或证明符合广告要求的文件,或缺少已签署的ETA-9089表格附录E,该申请将被视为不完整。
Under the proposed rule, a complete application consists of a Form ETA-9089, Application for Permanent Employment Certification, with all required fields completed with valid information, a valid PWD, and the employer's recruitment report for the job opportunity offered on the Application for Permanent Employment Certification, as outlined in proposed section 656.10(a). Despite form instructions and FLAG system prompts designed to ensure employers submit complete Applications for Permanent Employment Certification, the Department receives applications missing required information. The Department has received applications where the employer overrode system prompts or entered nonsensical or placeholder information ( e.g., the employer's point of contact as a movie or cartoon character or “TBD” (to be determined) or “Test Subject” as the alien's name) in order to circumvent system prompts meant to ensure only complete, valid applications are submitted. The Department anticipates that it will continue to receive such applications, which slow processing of legitimate, complete applications filed by employers with a genuine need for workers. With this rule's proposed addition of the employer's recruitment report and other recruitment related documentation as an application filing requirement, the Department also anticipates that an unscrupulous employer may try to circumvent these requirements by uploading into FLAG something other than their recruitment documentation to likewise evade system checks. Without, for example, a valid recruitment report or documentation demonstrating compliance with the advertising requirements or a signed Form ETA-9089, Appendix E, the application will be deemed incomplete.
根据拟议规则,提交至国家处理中心(NPC)的不完整《永久就业证明申请》将不予处理。确切而言,当发现某一《永久就业证明申请》不完整时,即该申请按照拟议第656.19(a)条的规定被分配给分析员进行审查时,国家处理中心将把该申请原样退回,不作处理。由于认证官(CO)在将不完整的申请原样退回之前不会作出任何实质性认定,拟议第656.10(g)条明确规定,雇主不得在申请因不完整而被国家处理中心原样退回后,依据第656.26条请求复议或复审。此外,该不完整申请的“提交日期”将不予保留,亦不得援引作为确定优先日期之依据。相反,雇主可以重新提交一份完整且符合第656部分所有要求的《永久就业证明申请》,其提交日期应为国家处理中心接受该新的完整申请进行处理之日,此依据拟议第656.10(f)条执行。
Under the proposed rule, incomplete Applications for Permanent Employment Certification submitted to the NPC will not be processed. Rather, when an incomplete Application for Permanent Employment Certification is discovered—which would occur when the application is assigned to an analyst for review, as provided in proposed section 656.19(a)—the NPC would return the application unprocessed. As the CO will not reach any substantive determinations before returning an incomplete application unprocessed, proposed section 656.10(g) clarifies that an employer cannot request reconsideration or review pursuant to section 656.26 after an application is returned by the NPC unprocessed due to incompleteness. In addition, the “filing date” of the incomplete application would not be retained and cannot be claimed for purposes of establishing a priority date. Rather, the employer may file a new Application for Permanent Employment Certification that is complete and satisfies all requirements of part 656 and the filing date would be the date the NPC accepts the new complete application for processing, in accordance with proposed section 656.10(f).
劳工部认识到,针对提交不完整申请所拟议的后果,较现行规则更为严格。然而,鉴于本届政府为打击签证欺诈和滥用行为、并确保在授予永久劳工证明之前,让最广泛的合格美国劳工群体(印刷页73941)公平获得这些工作机会所作出的广泛努力,劳工部认为,这些后果对于保障有限资源、并促进对完整且真实提交的申请进行处理而言是适当的。
The Department recognizes that the proposed consequences for submission of an incomplete application are more strict than under the current rule. However, in light of the Administration's broad efforts to combat visa fraud and abuse and ensure the broadest pool of qualified U.S. workers ( printed page 73941) have fair access to these job opportunities before a permanent labor certification is granted, the Department considers the consequences appropriate to safeguard limited resources and facilitate the processing of complete, genuinely filed applications.
同样,考虑到将申请原样退回不予处理所产生的后果,劳工部仅意图在申请明显不完整的情形下行使此项权力。例如,当提交的文件并非招聘报告、所含的现行工资确定(PWD)无效、雇主被列为虚构实体,或要求填写的字段中包含诸如“待定(TBD)”之类的占位内容时。本规定并非旨在允许劳工部在不允许向外国劳工认证上诉委员会(BALCA)申请复议或复审的情况下作出实质性拒绝决定。本规定旨在使外国劳工认证办公室(OFLC)无需为那些未能达到合法、完整申请基本标准的申请耗费时间进行审查并撰写拒绝决定书。
Likewise, recognizing the consequence of returning an application unprocessed, the Department only intends to exercise this authority in situations where it is clear that the application is incomplete. For example, when a document other than the recruitment report is submitted, when the included PWD is invalid, when the employer is listed as a fictional entity, or when required fields include placeholders like “TBD.” This provision is not intended to allow the Department to make substantive denials without permitting reconsideration or review by BALCA. The provision is intended to permit OFLC to avoid spending time reviewing and drafting denials for applications which fail to meet the basic standards of a legitimate, complete application.
记录留存要求
Record Retention Requirements
劳工部拟议保留雇主的记录留存要求,但寻求将该规定从现行第656.10(f)条迁移至拟议第656.10(h)条,并对雇主留存所有文件所需的时限作出修改。目前,雇主须留存一份《永久就业证明申请》副本及所有辅助文件,以证明其遵守了该项目要求,留存期限为5年,该5年期限自《永久就业证明申请》提交之日起算。劳工部拟议保留5年的留存期限,但将该5年期限的起算点改为移民申请获批准、被拒绝或被撤回之日。如果雇主未继续提交移民申请,则须自劳工证明到期之日或被拒绝、撤回之日起,将与《永久就业证明申请》相关的所有记录留存5年。
The Department proposes to retain the employer's record retention requirements, but it is seeking to relocate this provision from current section 656.10(f) to proposed section 656.10(h), with a change to the timeframe that would be required for employers to retain all documentation. Currently, employers are required to retain a copy of the Application for Permanent Employment Certification and all supporting documentation to demonstrate compliance with program requirements for a 5-year period, with the 5-year period beginning on the date the Application for Permanent Employment Certification was filed. The Department proposes to retain the 5-year period of retention, but to count the 5-year period of retention from the date on which the Immigrant Petition is approved, denied, or withdrawn. If the employer does not proceed to file an Immigrant Petition, it would be required to retain all records associated with the Application for Permanent Employment Certification for a period of 5 years from the expiration of the labor certification or the date of denial or withdrawal.
目前的记录留存时限与申请处理时限相互重叠,因而未能提供完整的5年记录留存期。通过将记录留存期的起算时点,改为针对被拒绝或被撤回申请的最终决定之日,或已获认证申请的到期之日,或(如有)移民申请获批准、被拒绝或被撤回之日起算,必要的记录将在完整的预期期限内可供查阅,从而使劳工部及其他合作机构得以在必要时,要求并获取这些记录,以便开展进一步审查、调查或任何诚信维护行动。
The current record retention timeframe overlaps with application processing timeframes and, in doing so, it fails to provide a full 5-year record retention period. By starting the record retention clock with the final determination for denied or withdrawn applications or the expiration of a certified application, or from the date on which the Immigrant Petition, if any, is approved, denied, or withdrawn, essential records will be available for the full period intended, which allows the Department, and other partner agencies, to request and obtain these records, if necessary, in order to conduct further review, investigations or any integrity actions.
第656.10条的适用性
Applicability of Section 656.10
劳工部为明确起见重申,第656.10条中提议的申请程序将适用于所有为了向美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)提交I-140申请而需要从外国劳工认证办公室(OFLC)获得永久劳工认证(PERM)的雇主。这将包括目前属于附表A(Schedule A)范围内的工作机会以及某些牧羊人,这与劳工部提议取消现行第656.15条(附表A)和第656.16条(牧羊人)所规定的替代性监管程序的做法相一致。
The Department reiterates for clarity that the filing procedures proposed in section 656.10 would apply to all employers required to obtain a PERM labor certification from OFLC for purposes of submitting an I-140 petition to USCIS. This would include job opportunities currently covered under Schedule A and certain sheepherders, consistent with the Department's proposals to eliminate current alternative regulatory procedures at sections 656.15 (Schedule A) and 656.16 (Sheepherders).
通过这一拟议变更,寻求永久雇用外国人从事目前根据第656部分被界定为附表A或符合资格的牧羊人工作机会的雇主,将继续从OFLC获得现行工资裁定(PWD),但此后还将被要求开展招聘前程序,并将其申请连同招聘报告提交给OFLC,而非提交给USCIS。
With this proposed change, employers seeking to permanently hire aliens to perform job opportunities currently defined as Schedule A or as qualifying sheepherders under part 656 would continue to obtain a PWD from OFLC but, going forward, also would be required to engage in pre-filing recruitment and submit their application to OFLC, rather than to USCIS, along with their recruitment report.
同样,拟议第656.10条中的申请要求将适用于寻求永久雇用外国人担任职业运动员或职业运动队教练、且其工作机会受EB-2或EB-3签证类别要求约束的雇主,包括目前属于附表A范围内的情形,根据本拟议规则,此类情形将需要获得PERM劳工认证。[72]
Similarly, the filing requirements in proposed section 656.10 would apply to employers seeking to permanently employ aliens as professional athletes or professional sports team coaches in job opportunities subject to the EB-2 or EB-3 visa classifications requirements, including those currently covered by Schedule A, which would require a PERM labor certification under this proposed rule.[72]
被取消的条款
Eliminated Provision
劳工部提议全文取消现行规则第656.10(e)条。提议取消现行第656.10(e)条的做法,与劳工部简化其PERM项目法规的目标相一致。
The Department proposes to eliminate section 656.10(e) of the current rule in its entirety. The proposed elimination of current section 656.10(e) is consistent with the Department's goal of simplifying its PERM program regulations.
现行第656.10(e)(1)条规定,公众可以向签证官(CO)提交可能与永久就业证明申请有关的证据。该条款与雇佣通知(NOF)的功能重复,后者同样邀请任何人向外国劳工证明办公室(OFLC)提供可能与永久就业证明申请有关的信息或其他文件,以供其在作出PERM劳工证明所需决定时参考。参见拟议第656.14(d)条。使用雇佣通知(NOF)中提供的联系方式向外国劳工证明办公室(OFLC)提交的信息或其他文件的类型,与现行第656.10(e)(1)条所述的类型相同,即关于可用工人的信息、关于工资和工作条件的信息,以及关于雇主未能满足雇用外国人和同类受雇工人所需条款和条件的信息。此外,正如下文关于劳工部拟议扩大雇佣通知(NOF)可见度的讨论所述,拟议取消现行第656.10(e)(1)条将简化该法规,而不会影响项目的完整性。
Current section 656.10(e)(1) states that the public may submit evidence to the CO that may have bearing on an Application for Permanent Employment Certification. This provision duplicates the function of the NOF, which similarly invites any person to provide information or other documentation bearing on an Application for Permanent Employment Certification to OFLC for consideration in reaching the determinations required for PERM labor certification. See proposed section 656.14(d). The type of information or other documentation to be submitted to OFLC using the contact information provided in the NOF is the same as that described in current 656.10(e)(1)—information on available workers, information on wages and working conditions, and information on the employer's failure to meet the terms and conditions for the employment of aliens and similarly employed workers. In addition, as discussed below in connection with the Department's proposed expansion of NOF visibility, the proposed elimination of current section 656.10(e)(1) would simplify the regulation without impact to program integrity.
劳工部还建议取消现行第656.10(e)(2)条,该条讨论向国土安全部(DHS)提交证据的事宜。尽管劳工部知悉国土安全部(DHS)接受并考虑此类信息,但取消现行第656.10(e)(2)条符合劳工部通过删除讨论另一机构程序内容来简化第656部分的意图。
The Department also proposes to eliminate current section 656.10(e)(2), which discusses the submission of evidence to DHS. Although the Department is aware that DHS accepts and considers such information, the elimination of current section 656.10(e)(2) is consistent with the Department's intent to simplify part 656 by eliminating regulatory content that discusses another agency's processes.
二、拟议的20 CFR 656.11条,申请的替换与修改
2. Proposed 20 CFR 656.11, Substitutions and Modifications to Applications
在本次规则制定中,劳工部建议保留现行第656.11条中关于禁止替换外国人以及修改永久就业证明申请的规定,但对其进行修订,以更新术语、删除过时的措辞并提高清晰度。例如,拟议修订将“申请”替换为“永久就业证明申请”,以及其他一些细微修订。
In this rulemaking, the Department proposes to retain current section 656.11's prohibitions on substituting aliens and modifying Applications for Permanent Employment Certification, with revisions to update terminology, eliminate outdated language, and improve clarity. For example, proposed revisions replace “application” with “ Application for Permanent Employment Certification,” among other minor revisions.
劳工部还建议删除对2007年7月16日的提及,因为这些提及已不再必要。在现行第656.11条确立之前,劳工部允许雇主将永久劳工证明上列明的外国人替换为另一名预期的外国人。劳工证明替换既可以在PERM劳工证明申请在劳工部待决期间进行,也可以根据劳工部授予国土安全部(DHS)的授权,在基于已获批准的PERM劳工证明而提交或待决于国土安全部(DHS)的I-140表格申请期间进行。(印刷页第73942页)这种做法之所以被允许,是因为获得PERM劳工证明和I-140表格申请批准所需的时间较长。
The Department also proposes removing references to July 16, 2007, which are no longer necessary. Prior to the establishment of current section 656.11, the Department allowed employers to substitute an alien named on a permanent labor certification with another prospective alien. Labor certification substitution occurred either while the PERM labor certification application was pending with the Department or, by the Department's delegation to DHS, when a Form I-140 petition was submitted or was pending with DHS based on an approved PERM labor certification. This practice was ( printed page 73942) permitted due to the length of time it took to obtain a PERM labor certification and Form I-140 petition approval.
2007年5月17日,劳工部发布了最终规则《在美国为外国人办理永久就业劳工证;减少欺诈和滥用的诱因与机会并增强项目完整性》(简称“2007年欺诈规则”),劳工部通过该规则以规章制定的方式取消了在永久劳工认证(PERM)劳工证上替换外国人的做法。[73] 在2007年欺诈规则中,劳工部规定,在向劳工部提交的任何永久劳工认证(PERM)申请以及由此产生的任何证明文件上,均禁止替换或变更外国人的身份。[74] 参见现行20 CFR 656.11(a)。该2007年规则还修订了现行第656.30(c)(2)条,规定永久劳工认证(PERM)劳工证仅对原始永久劳工认证(PERM)申请中所列明的外国人有效。[75]
On May 17, 2007, the Department issued the Final Rule, Labor Certification for the Permanent Employment of Aliens in the United States; Reducing the Incentives and Opportunities for Fraud and Abuse and Enhancing Program Integrity (“2007 Fraud Rule”), through which the Department eliminated the practice of allowing the substitution of aliens on PERM labor certifications through rulemaking.[73] In the 2007 Fraud Rule, the Department established that substitution or change to the identity of an alien was prohibited on any application filed with the Department for PERM labor certification and on any resulting certification.[74] See current 20 CFR 656.11(a). The 2007 rule also revised current section 656.30(c)(2) to state that a PERM labor certification is only valid for the alien named on the original PERM labor certification application.[75]
此外,2007年欺诈规则明确规定,对于在该最终规则生效日期之后提交的申请,不接受对申请进行修改的请求。参见现行20 CFR 656.11(b)。劳工部解释称,其已在永久劳工认证(PERM)项目中实施了技术变更,以提醒申请人注意可能导致拒绝的技术性缺陷,从而消除了许多修改请求的必要性。[76]
Further, the 2007 Fraud Rule clarified that requests for modifications to an application, where the application was filed after the final rule's effective date, would not be accepted. See current 20 CFR 656.11(b). The Department explained that it had implemented technological changes in the PERM program to alert applicants to technical grounds for deniability, thus eliminating the need for many modifications.[76]
劳工部无意修改第656.11(b)条,以允许在《永久就业认证申请》审理过程中或(如已获认证)认证之后对其进行实质性变更。实质性变更是指若不加以更正将导致申请被拒绝的错误的更正。雇主承担证明其符合永久劳工认证(PERM)劳工证资格条件的举证责任,并有责任提交完整准确的《永久就业认证申请》。
The Department has no intention of changing section 656.11(b) to permit substantive changes to an Application for Permanent Employment Certification, while in process or after certification, if certified. A substantive change is one that would correct an error that would lead to denial, if not corrected. The employer has the burden of proof to establish eligibility for a PERM labor certification and the responsibility to submit a complete and accurate Application for Permanent Employment Certification.
劳工部已经考虑了在《永久就业认证申请》尚在国家处理中心(NPC)审理期间,应如何适当允许对其进行微小修改。所谓微小修改,是指劳工部所指的那些对认证官(CO)评估雇主是否符合项目要求不产生影响的错误。如果更正某一错误可避免申请被拒绝,则该错误并非微小错误,对其的更正也不属于微小修改。此外,劳工部无意允许更正那些显然本可通过更加细心而避免的错误,例如荒谬的错误(例如占位符或卡通人物)或同一申请中出现的多处错误(即便可以说属于笔误性质)。相反,劳工部将考虑允许更正单一、孤立的纯属笔误性质的错误,以便在适当情况下避免雇主与国家处理中心(NPC)双方因撤回并重新提交而浪费资源。
The Department has considered how it might appropriately permit minor modifications to an Application for Permanent Employment Certification while it is pending with the NPC. By minor modifications, the Department refers to errors that have no bearing on the CO's assessment of the employer's compliance with program requirements. An error is not minor—and its correction would not be a minor modification—if its correction would prevent denial. In addition, the Department has no interest in permitting correction of errors that clearly could have been prevented with closer attention, such as ridiculous errors ( e.g., place holders or cartoon characters) or multiple errors—even if arguably clerical—in the same application. Rather, the Department would consider allowing correction of isolated instances of purely clerical errors for which correction could be appropriate to avoid wasted resources of withdrawing and refiling for both the employer and the NPC.
劳工部邀请各界就是否应修订第656部分以允许任何微小修改,以及若如此,应在何种条件下允许微小修改而不损害项目完整性或项目效率提出意见。有益的意见应就以下方面进行讨论:请求微小修改的时限限制(例如,在提交申请后30个日历日内,或在认证官(CO)作出最终决定之前);微小修改的范围并附具体示例(例如,更正外国人的出生日期、签证类别或电话号码,或将代理人或律师信息替换为新代理人的信息);以及识别不包含实质性信息的表格字段,因为实质性信息不得被修改。
The Department invites comments about whether part 656 should be revised to permit any minor modifications and, if so, the conditions under which minor modifications could be permitted without impact to program integrity or program efficiency. Helpful comments will discuss time period limitations for requesting a minor modification ( e.g., within the 30 calendar days after filing or prior to the issuance of a final determination by the CO); the scope of minor modifications with examples ( e.g., correcting a birthdate, visa classification or phone number for the alien or replacing an agent or attorney information with a new representative's information) and identifying form fields that do not contain substantive information, as substantive information could not be modified.
3. 拟议的20 CFR 656.12条,不当商业交易与付款
3. Proposed 20 CFR 656.12, Improper Commerce and Payment
劳工部通过2007年欺诈规则,对取得和使用待批准或已批准的永久劳工证申请施加了明确限制,以减少永久劳工认证项目中欺诈和滥用的诱因与机会,并提出增强永久劳工认证项目完整性的措施。[77] 2007年欺诈规则对第656.12(a)条进行了修订,全面禁止买卖、以物易物及购买劳工证申请及其证明文件。该修订适用于在2007年欺诈规则生效日期当日或之后提交的申请,无论所涉及的劳工证申请是依据2005年3月28日之前有效的20 CFR第656部分法规提交,还是在2005年3月28日当日或之后提交。[78]
Through the 2007 Fraud Rule, the Department imposed clear limitations on the acquisition and use of a pending or approved permanent labor certification application to reduce the incentives and opportunities for fraud and abuse in the permanent labor certification program and to propose measures to enhance the integrity of the permanent labor certification program.[77] The 2007 Fraud Rule revised section 656.12(a) to create a complete ban on the sale, barter, and purchase of labor certification applications and certifications. The revisions applied to applications filed on or after the effective date of the 2007 Fraud Rule regardless of whether the labor certification application involved was filed under the regulations of 20 CFR part 656 in effect before March 28, 2005, or, on or after, March 28, 2005.[78]
根据本拟议规则,劳工部拟取消第656.12条引言部分中与2004年PERM最终规则[79]和2007年欺诈规则相关的过渡程序,因为该条款中的过渡程序已经过时。
Under this proposed rule, the Department proposes to eliminate the transition procedures in the introductory part of section 656.12 related to the 2004 PERM Final Rule [79] and the 2007 Fraud Rule because the transition procedures in this section are obsolete.
现行第656.12条规定其适用于“本部分项下的申请”以及“因该等申请而产生的证明”,同时在第656.12(a)款和第656.12(c)款中规定这些条款仅适用于“已获批准的永久劳工证明”。劳工部拟议的引言性语言旨在明确,第656.12条的规定适用于任何永久就业证明申请以及任何PERM劳工证明。拟议的术语变更有助于更好地界定永久就业证明申请各种可能结果(例如,核准、撤回、宣告无效、撤销)的范围,并继续提醒雇主注意,其根据第656部分提出的永久就业证明申请及PERM劳工证明须受第656.12条规定的约束。
The current section 656.12 states that it applies to applications “under this part” and “certifications resulting from those applications,” while stating in sections 656.12(a) and (c) that those provisions only apply to “ approved permanent labor certifications.” The Department's proposed introductory language serves to clarify that the provisions of section 656.12 apply to any Application for Permanent Employment Certification and any PERM labor certification. The proposed terminology changes serve to better frame the scope of various possible outcomes for Applications for Permanent Employment Certification ( e.g., certification, withdrawal, invalidation, revocation) and continue to place employers on notice that their Applications for Permanent Employment Certification and PERM labor certifications under part 656 are subject to the provisions of section 656.12.
4. 拟新增20 CFR第656.13条,雇主的保证与义务
4. Proposed New 20 CFR 656.13, Assurances and Obligations of Employers
劳工部拟新设第656.13条,按主题列举雇主在PERM项目下必须保证遵守的各项保证与义务。将所有现行及新拟议的必要声明整合于一个条款之中,将有助于提高第656部分内容的清晰度和可检索性,这与劳工部在H-1B、H-2A和H-2B项目中设有的类似监管条款做法一致。[80] 劳工部认为,通过在法规的一个条款中明确规定雇主的法律义务,这种方式将使雇主更容易查找、理解并遵守项目要求。此外,第656.13条拟议的修改将加强对美国工人的保护,包括对美国工人工资的保护,并促进对美国工人就业机会的优先考虑,特别是通过扩大裁员情形下的联系与考虑要求,并防止雇主通过裁减美国工人来制造职位空缺的假象,进而出于以外国人取代被裁减美国工人的意图提交永久就业证明申请(印刷页第73943页)来实现这一目的。参见拟议第656.13(e)款和第656.13(f)款。
The Department is proposing the creation of a new section at 656.13 to enumerate by topic the assurances and obligations under the PERM program to which an employer must attest compliance. Organizing all existing and newly proposed required attestations into one section will improve clarity and navigation within part 656 and part 656 with similar regulatory provisions the Department has in the H-1B, H-2A and H-2B programs.[80] By clearly stating the employer's legal obligations in one provision of the regulations, the Department has determined this approach will make it easier for employers to find, understand, and comply with the program requirements. Further, the proposed changes in section 656.13 would enhance protections for U.S. workers, including protection of U.S. worker wages, and promote consideration of U.S. workers for job opportunities, notably by expanding contact and consideration requirements in layoff situations and preventing employers from laying off U.S. workers to create the perception of available vacancies and filing an Application for Permanent Employment Certification with the intention of ( printed page 73943) replacing laid off U.S. workers with aliens. See proposed 656.13(e) and (f).
根据拟议的第656.13条,雇主在依据第656部分提交申请时,须阅读并同意遵守有关美国工人及外国人的基本项目要求和工人保护规定,这将提高项目的诚信度。雇主须在承担伪证罪责的前提下保证,其已阅读并审阅了永久就业证明申请表的每一页内容,包括所有适用的附录和辅助文件,并保证据其所知,其中所载信息真实准确。此外,雇主须保证其理解,根据18 U.S.C. 第2条、第1001条、第1546条、第1621条的规定,在编制本表格及其任何补充文件过程中明知并且/或故意提供重大虚假信息,或协助、教唆、建议他人实施此类行为,均构成联邦犯罪,可处以罚款、监禁或两者并罚。更为明确的要求也将增强劳工部的项目诚信工作成效,因为更为明确的要求为执行项目要求提供了更为直接的途径。
For proposed section 656.13, employers will be required to read and agree to comply with essential program requirements and worker protections for both U.S. and aliens when submitting an application under part 656, which will improve program integrity. Under penalty of perjury, employers will attest that they have read and reviewed every page of the Application for Permanent Employment Certification, including all applicable appendices and supporting documentation, and to the best of their knowledge the information contained therein is true and accurate. In addition, employers will assure they understand that knowingly and/or willfully furnishing materially false information in the preparation of this form and any supplement thereto or to aid, abet, or counsel another to do so is a federal offense punishable by fines, imprisonment, or both under 18 U.S.C. 2, 1001, 1546, 1621. The clearer requirements will also enhance the Department's program integrity efforts, as clearer requirements provide a more straightforward path for enforcement of program requirements.
具体而言,劳工部提议将现行载于第656.10(c)条的必要声明予以替换,并迁移至本拟议新第656.13条,同时进一步替换现行声明的措辞,以加强项目的完整性。劳工部提议将现行第656.10(c)条中说明声明的性质和效力的监管内容予以替换,并迁移至拟议第656.13条的引言部分。此外,劳工部还提议将现行第656.10条、第656.12条、第656.17条和第656.20条中的其他现有义务迁移至拟议第656.13条,并进一步对其加以修订,以形成明确的雇主声明,从而达到澄清和(或)更新合规要求的目的。最后,劳工部还通过本拟议规则提出新的声明,以体现新的要求。本规则中的各项提案通过要求选择参与永久劳工证(PERM)项目的雇主对劳工部负责,并履行其对美国工人和外国人的职责,就雇主提交永久就业证明申请及参与永久劳工证(PERM)项目而言,加强了对美国工人的保护,并强化了项目的完整性。
Specifically, the Department is proposing to take existing required attestations, currently codified at section 656.10(c), and replace and relocate them to this new proposed section 656.13, while further replacing the language of the existing attestations to strengthen program integrity. The Department proposes to replace and relocate regulatory content explaining the nature and effect of attestations from current section 656.10(c) to the introductory language of proposed section 656.13. In addition, the Department is proposing to relocate other existing obligations from current sections 656.10, 656.12, 656.17, and 656.20 to proposed section 656.13, again further revising them to create clear employer attestations in efforts to clarify and/or update compliance requirements. Finally, the Department also proposes new attestations to reflect new requirements through this proposed rule. The proposals in this rule strengthen U.S. worker protections and bolster program integrity by holding employers who choose to participate in the PERM program accountable to the Department, and to their responsibilities to both U.S. workers and aliens, with regard to the employer's filing of the Application for Permanent Employment Certification and participation in the PERM program.
拟议新增的第656.13(a)条继续要求寻求永久雇用外国人的雇主证明该工作机会是真实的、全职的、永久性职位,并新增规定雇佣条款和条件必须符合所有适用法律法规,这与现行第656.10(c)(7)和(1)条的规定一致。该拟议修订继续保留现行第656.10(c)(5)、(8)和(9)条的证明要求,要求雇主证明该工作机会此前及目前均向任何合格的美国工人开放,任何申请该职位的美国工人均因合法的、与工作相关的理由而被拒绝,且该工作机会不涉及非法歧视。劳工部提议扩大该证明要求,使永久就业证明申请所涉及的工作机会,在雇主为该外国人在美国永久就业建立担保资格期间,即自提交永久就业证明申请之日起,至美国公民及移民服务局(USCIS)批准I-140表格申请之日,或者,如永久就业证明申请或I-140表格申请被拒绝或撤回,则以裁定之日为准,两者以较晚者为准,在此整个期间内,在相同或相似职业的就业地点,始终向雇主的被裁员工保持开放,该永久就业证明申请将构成该外国人申请签证并以永久居民身份入境美国的依据。[81]此外,该条款新增明确要求雇主遵守1964年《民权法案》第七章的规定,该章禁止因种族、肤色、宗教、性别或民族血统而在雇佣条款、条件或待遇方面实施工作场所歧视。第七章中的任何规定均“未将基于公民身份或外侨身份的歧视定为非法”。参见Espinoza诉Farah制造公司案,414 U.S. 86, 95(1973)。该条款还新增要求遵守《移民与国籍法》中的反歧视条款,即8 U.S.C. 1324b,该条款禁止因受保护个人的公民身份而实施歧视,对于不受第七章管辖的雇主,还禁止因民族血统而实施歧视。该法律规定,基于公民身份而歧视美国公民或国民,属于与移民相关的不公平雇佣行为。参见8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(1)、(3)。
Proposed new section 656.13(a) continues to require an employer seeking to permanently employ an alien to attest that the job opportunity is a bona fide, full-time, permanent position and adds that the terms and conditions of employment must comply with all applicable laws and regulations, consistent with current sections 656.10(c)(7) and (1). This proposed revision continues current sections 656.10(c)(5), (8), and (9) attestations, requiring the employer to attest that the job opportunity has been and is open to any qualified U.S. worker, any U.S. worker who applied was rejected for lawful, job-related reasons, and the job opportunity does not involve unlawful discrimination. The Department proposes to expand this attestation so that the job opportunities that are the subject of Applications for Permanent Employment Certification remain open to the employer's laid off-employees in the place(s) of employment in the same or similar occupation throughout the period in which the employer is establishing its sponsorship of an alien for permanent employment in the United States—between filing the Application for Permanent Employment Certification and the date the Form I-140 petition is approved by USCIS or the date of determination, if the Application for Permanent Employment Certification or Form I-140 petition is denied or withdrawn, whichever is later, which would form the basis for the alien's application for a visa and admission to the United States as a permanent resident.[81] In addition, the provision adds language explicitly requiring employers to comply with Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, which prohibits workplace discrimination in the terms, conditions, or privileges of employment because of race, color, religion, sex, or national origin. Nothing in Title VII, “makes it illegal to discriminate on the basis of citizenship or alienage.” Espinoza v. Farah Mfg. Co., 414 U.S. 86, 95 (1973). The provision also adds language requiring compliance with the Antidiscrimination Provision of the Immigration and Nationality Act, 8 U.S.C. 1324b, which prohibits discrimination because of citizenship status against protected individuals and, for employers not covered by Title VII, because of national origin. That law states that it is an unfair immigration-related employment practice to discriminate against a citizen or national of the United States based on their citizenship status. 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(1), (3).
另外,根据劳工部依据8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(5)(A)(i)(II)所拥有的自身职权,拟议第656.13(a)(5)条要求雇主向美国工人提供的雇佣条款、条件和特权不得低于向外籍劳工提供的待遇。遵守永久劳工认证(PERM)要求只是最低标准,并不等同于遵守《民权法案》第七章或8 U.S.C. 1324b的规定,偏离PERM要求的行为可作为依据上述法律提起执法行动或私人诉讼时的相关证据。本条款将禁止雇主以任何成本理由或依据拒绝合格的美国工人而优先考虑拟聘用的外籍劳工,包括合格美国工人与拟聘用外籍劳工之间在任何雇佣条款、条件或特权以及薪酬和附加福利方面的差异。该拟议条款对于确保PERM项目的完整性是必要的,可防止出现职位招聘被设计为专门匹配特定外籍劳工技能的情形。过度限制性的职位招聘广告会对回应职位空缺招聘广告的合格美国工人人数产生抑制效应,劳工部将通过本提案禁止此类做法。这些提案加强了对美国工人的保护,并通过要求参与该项目的美国雇主在永久就业证明申请处理之外,对劳工部和美国工人承担责任,从而增强了项目的完整性。
Separately, and under the Department's own authority in 8 U.S.C. 1182(a)(5)(A)(i)(II), proposed section 656.13(a)(5) requires employers to offer U.S. workers terms, conditions, and privileges of employment no less favorable than those offered to the alien. Compliance with the PERM requirements is a floor; it does not establish compliance with Title VII or 8 U.S.C. 1324b, and a departure from the PERM requirements may be relevant evidence in an enforcement action or private suit under those laws.
